item.title: Week of 2026-09-07: 16 alive / 31 fading / 26 dead — what changed
item.description: Week of 2026-09-07: 16 alive / 31 fading / 26 dead — what changed
item.content:encoded:
• This run covers 116 strategy/asset/timeframe rows: 16 ALIVE, 31 FADING, 26 DEAD, 15 with too few trades.
  • No verdict changed since the 2026-09-06 run.
  • Among rows with at least 30 out-of-sample trades, the highest was 2.22 (Price above SMA (n200) on ETHUSD 4h); the lowest was 0.56 (Volatility breakout + trend filter (k0.5-sma20) on BTCUSD 4h).

Biggest fee drag: 254.7% on Larry Williams volatility breakout (k0.5) on ETHUSD 4h.
